## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Authorized human reviews the remediation
- [ ] Security-specific and regression tests pass
- [ ] Required secrets or vulnerable artifacts are rotated or removed
- [ ] CI / CodeQL / dependency checks pass
- [ ] Rollout, rollback, monitoring, and disclosure actions are complete

## Definition of Ready

- [ ] Restricted evidence is available to authorized implementers
- [ ] `docs/process/DEFINITION-OF-READY.md` passes
- [ ] Required human gates are named
